title: 100 People vs the Ice Age (test opening)
style_suffix: bold ink outlines, bulging cartoon eyes, painterly background, bright comfortable colours, 2D hand-drawn animation still

characters.walter: Walter, a skinny old man in his seventies, bald head with white side tufts, round glasses, bushy white eyebrows, brown tweed coat with elbow patches, red scarf
characters.rosa: Rosa, a sturdy woman in her forties, curly black hair in a bun, blue nurse scrubs under an open purple puffer jacket
characters.maya: Maya, a sixteen-year-old girl, short pink-dyed hair, oversized yellow hoodie, big headphones around her neck
characters.tom: Tom, a big broad-shouldered man in his thirties, thick ginger beard, green beanie, grey work overalls with a tool belt

plates.tundra: a vast empty ice age tundra under a pale sky, deep snow, a gigantic white glacier wall along the whole horizon, no people, no buildings
plates.bus: a modern yellow and white city bus standing alone in deep snow

shots.first: inside a packed modern city bus at seven in the morning, tired commuters, Rosa holding a coffee, Tom standing with a toolbox, Maya slumped with her phone, Walter talking to nobody, warm morning light
shots.last: the same bus interior, a blinding white flash floods through every window, all passengers shielding their eyes
shots.motion: the passengers sway with the bus, then a blinding white light floods through the windows and everyone shields their eyes

shots.first: wide shot, a lone modern city bus standing in a vast snowy ice age plain, steam rising from the engine, a glacier wall on the far horizon
shots.last: the same wide shot, the bus doors are open and a few tiny figures step into the snow
shots.motion: steam drifts from the stalled bus, snow blows across the plain, the bus doors fold open and small figures climb out

shots.first: low angle at the open bus door, Rosa and Tom stepping down, their breath steaming in freezing air, shocked faces
shots.last: close on their sneakers and boots sinking knee deep into fresh snow
shots.motion: Rosa and Tom step down from the bus into deep snow, cold wind hits their faces, their breath steams

shots.first: medium close-up of Walter squinting at the horizon, wind in his scarf, snowy plain behind him
shots.last: Walter with huge wide eyes and an open mouth, raising a trembling finger to point at the horizon
shots.motion: Walter squints, adjusts his glasses, then his eyes go wide and he slowly raises a finger to point

shots.first: extreme wide shot, a gigantic white glacier wall towering over the horizon, a tiny bus and tiny people in the foreground snow
shots.last: the same extreme wide shot slightly closer to the glacier wall, the tiny people stand still and stare
shots.motion: slow push in toward the gigantic glacier wall, snow mist drifting at its base, the tiny people stand still

shots.first: close-up of Maya lifting her smartphone high above her head, hopeful face, snowy plain behind her
shots.last: close-up of Maya staring at her phone, her face falling, disappointed
shots.motion: Maya waves her phone in the air searching for signal, then looks at the screen and her face falls

shots.first: the four of them standing beside the bus in snow, looking around nervously
shots.last: the same four people bracing themselves, snow falling off the bus roof as the ground shakes
shots.motion: the ground starts to shake, snow slides off the bus roof, the four people stumble and brace themselves

shots.first: a snowy ridge against a pale sky, empty
shots.last: a herd of huge shaggy woolly mammoths cresting the snowy ridge, long curved tusks
shots.motion: a herd of woolly mammoths rises over the ridge and walks forward, snow puffing under their feet

shots.first: woolly mammoths walking past the stalled bus, small frozen people pressed against the bus side
shots.last: the mammoths further along, the people still pressed against the bus, not moving
shots.motion: giant woolly mammoths lumber past the bus very close, the people stay frozen against the bus

shots.first: close-up of Tom holding his breath, eyes wide, a shaggy mammoth leg passing right behind him
shots.last: close-up of Tom wrinkling his nose at the smell, the mammoth passing behind
shots.motion: a shaggy mammoth walks past right behind Tom, he holds his breath, then wrinkles his nose

shots.first: a crowd in the snow splitting into three arguing groups, people pointing in different directions, Walter and Maya in the middle
shots.last: the three groups standing apart in the snow, arms crossed
shots.motion: people argue and point in different directions, then the crowd splits apart into three groups

shots.first: Rosa walking along a line of shivering people, counting on her fingers, only some wear winter coats
shots.last: Rosa stopping with a worried face, people in thin jackets hugging themselves
shots.motion: Rosa walks along the line of shivering people counting coats on her fingers, then stops and frowns

shots.first: the sun low over the ice age plain, orange sky, long blue shadows, the lonely bus
shots.last: the sun almost gone, deep purple sky, the plain turning dark blue
shots.motion: the sun sinks toward the horizon, shadows stretch and the sky turns from orange to purple

shots.first: people huddled together beside the bus in the blue dusk, shivering, breath steaming
shots.last: the same huddle, closer together, everyone shaking with cold
shots.motion: the people huddle closer together, shivering, rubbing their arms, breath steaming in the dusk

shots.first: close-up of Tom's hand pulling a small lighter out of his overalls pocket in the dark
shots.last: close-up of Tom's thumb on the lighter, a small bright flame lighting his face
shots.motion: Tom pulls out a lighter and flicks it, a small flame bursts to life and lights his face

shots.first: faces of Rosa, Maya and Walter in the dark, lit warm orange by a tiny flame, all staring at it
shots.last: the same faces, eyes turning from the flame to each other, suspicious
shots.motion: the small flame flickers on their faces, they stare at it, then glance at each other with suspicion
